quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Stop only if other traffic is coming.
Vehicles will enter the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the traffic rule. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are near a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are near a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before continuing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Prepare to move lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The light is about to turn green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns the signal is changing to red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if safe. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about school zones. It marks areas where children or pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: This white sign means:

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols and alert you to road conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What message will be found on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means "stop." You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to places where animals, people, and vehicles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for other traffic and pedestrians, and then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign tells you that traffic will be merging from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve right and then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk ahead. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that lanes are being reduced and traffic must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way street or entrance. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to immediate road conditions. This sign tells you to slow down. The road ahead makes a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with disability license plates or placards may park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided highway. You are now approaching a two-way road with traffic in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road curves right first, then left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must obey. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it on one-way streets or when trying to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you there is a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that another road crosses ahead. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is coming ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road is coming ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to possible dangers. This sign warns you that a side road will cross your path ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path first. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery and hard to drive on safely. Slow down in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that you could lose control of your vehicle. Slow down when the pavement is wet because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves and winds ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road ahead is divided.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only the direction you are going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and look in all directions for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on the back of slow-moving vehicles traveling below 25 mph. These include construction equipment, farm machinery, and horse-drawn vehicles.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or yield before turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Move to another lane if possible to let them merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Move to another lane if possible to let them merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you traffic is merging into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if you can. This gives merging drivers a safe path.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this intersection. It is illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may be merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing without signals. You should:

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see or hear one. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow-green warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells you that you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of curves ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is changing direction or getting narrower. You may see it on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Traffic fines can double in areas with these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns. It is illegal to turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road may be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about driver services. They show rest areas, food, hospitals, and other helpful facilities.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate dangers. This sign warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill section ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about work zones. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is coming. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk ahead. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell you about road conditions coming up. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yellow sign with black lettering means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits into two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always in the same order from top to bottom: red, yellow, and green.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This white sign with red and black markings tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Stay alert and prepare to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down and watch for children crossing.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be ready to stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign tell a driver?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing and use paddles or flags to direct traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road is intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see it on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.
